title: unified-rollouts: add safety guards for canary/AB/shadow autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: recent canary/AB/shadow autorollback rollouts have surfaced two classes of flakiness: noisy metrics causing premature rollbacks, and lack of quarantine for transient infra blips. This PR introduces safety guards to reduce false-positive autorollbacks and give operators a deterministic quarantine path.

What this PR does: adds a quarantine probing stage, metric quorum behavior, hysteresis windows for metric thresholds, stronger telemetry (per-rollout metric tags), preflight e2e checks, and new observability dashboards/alerts for rollback noise. The changes apply to canary, A/B and shadow rollout modes and the unified autorollback engine.

Design highlights: 
- Quarantine stage: when a rollback trigger fires, the rollout enters a quarantine probing stage that 1) ramps down traffic to the candidate, 2) runs a set of health probes (latency percentiles, error-rate probes, and model-quality probes) for a configurable window, and 3) requires a quorum of probes to fail before a full rollback.
- Metric quorum: rollback decisions now consider multiple metrics (latency_p95, error_rate, model_quality_regression) and require at least N metrics to exceed thresholds within the hysteresis window. Quorum is configurable per-policy.
- Hysteresis & cooldown: thresholds must be violated continuously for the hysteresis window before triggering quarantine; after an autorollback the rollout enters a cooldown to avoid flip-flopping.
- Observability: added rollout_scoped tags to existing metrics, new metrics for quarantine_entered/quarantine_duration/quarantine_outcome, and dashboards to visualize multi-metric quorum decisions.
- E2E & preflight: added preflight e2e test harness for canary/AB/shadow flows to catch regression on autorollback logic.

Checklist: 
- [x] Core autorollback engine changes + unit tests
- [x] Quarantine stage implementation and integration tests
- [x] Metric quorum + hysteresis logic + unit tests
- [x] Observability metrics and Grafana dashboard JSON
- [x] Preflight e2e tests added to CI (flaky guard added for infra)
- [x] Docs: unified-rollouts safety-guards.md updated

Compatibility & rollout plan: default quarantine/quorum parameters are conservative so existing rollouts will see minimal behavior change. We will enable the stronger defaults in staging for two weeks and then flip for prod. Rollout is feature-flagged behind rollout.safetyGuards.v1.

Related: ENG-3412 (safety guards design), ENG-3420 (observability for autorollback), SUP-9876 (incident where a transient region outage caused unnecessary rollback).

review_threads:
Liam Zhang: Can you clarify the default quorum values and why p95 was chosen over p99?
Aisha: p95 chosen based on historical sensitivity; quorum is conservative (2 of 3) and configurable.

Marco Ruiz: Telemetry tagging looks good but please use rollout_id and model_variant tags for per-rollout aggregation.
Aisha: added rollout_scoped tags in pkg/observability/metrics.go and updated dashboard queries.

Sofia Hernandez: e2e tests are flaky in CI occasionally — can we add a short retry wrapper?
Aisha: added a soft retry and infra-guard label so the job is non-blocking on first failures.

Liam Zhang: add unit test for cooldown to ensure no flip-flop after autorollback.
Aisha: added autorollback_cooldown_test in tests/unit.
ci_checks: e2e-preflight: flaky -> rerun passed on second attempt
release_notes: Adds safety guards to unified rollouts: quarantine probing stage, multi-metric quorum, hysteresis windows, cooldowns, new metrics and dashboards, and preflight e2e tests. Default params are conservative and feature-flagged.
notes_for_ops: Enable rollout.safetyGuards.v1 in staging for 14 days. Watch metrics rollout.quarantine_entered and rollout.quarantine_outcome; dashboard: rollouts-safety-guards. If rollback count spikes after enabling, revert flag or increase hysteresis window.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover quorum/hysteresis/cooldown paths. Integration tests validate state transitions. Preflight e2e uses a synthetic latency/error source and runs in the CI preflight pipeline; flaky guard allows one retry before marking as infra-flake. Observability panels added for manual verification.
